provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Old King's Crown rulebook (via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose game length: Standard 5 Rounds (recommended), Short 4 or Extended 6
Kingdom Board in reach, Councils Tile directly above it
Shuffle the Kingdom Cards facedown on the leftmost Great Road space; fill the 3 spaces faceup from the right, then flip the deck's top card (4 faceup)
Influence and Lore Tokens near the board as the Reserve
Kingdom's Favour Disc on the Harvest Field
Season Marker in the Spring slot; Round Marker on 1
Clash Markers stacked III (bottom) to I (top) in their slot
Choose or randomly assign Factions; take your Player Board
Your Herald and 5 Supporters in their slots on your board
Hand Size Marker top-left, starting-hand icon at the arrow
Your 4 Tactic Tiles text side up in the lower slot; follow any SETUP text on them
Faction Markers in a pile by your board; Site of Power Tile nearby
Search your Faction Deck for the 5 Advanced Faction and HQ cards (Lore cost top right); faceup on your Site of Power
Set aside your Heir, shuffle the rest facedown left of your board, take the Heir and draw up to {n} cards
Order Markers on the Order Track oldest to youngest (or random)
First on the Order Track takes the Active Player Marker
Start of the Year: draw cards
